collection.description: Two old friends remember the same childhood fall into the stream, but each remembers the other falling in.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) were children together, and tonight by the fire they are remembering the day somebody fell into the stream trying to catch a frog. They both remember it perfectly. The trouble is that (subject) remembers (friend) falling in, and (friend) remembers (subject) falling in.

choices.label: Ask the Others at the Fire

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They put it to the whole fire. Opinions are split. (elder), an elder, remembers that nobody fell in at all, and that it was a lizard, not a frog. Another, (other), says it was both of them, and the frog too. By the end of the night there are five versions of the story, and everyone likes theirs best.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Fine," says (subject). "It was you." "It was YOU," says (friend). They grin at each other. Neither of them will ever give in, and both of them, privately, have started to wonder. The frog, wherever it is now, isn't telling.
